name: Acquire market-driven experience end to end

userStory.actor: a professional closing a chosen market-relevant experience gap
userStory.intent: resolve the gap, project a mission for it, and admit testimony proving the mission was completed, in one composed circuit
userStory.outcome: inspect the full lineage from market signal to admitted experience evidence, and a ready-to-append experience-log entry, without re-deriving any of the three capabilities by hand

experience.actor: a professional closing a chosen market-relevant experience gap
experience.promise: I can inspect the full lineage from an unsupported market signal to admitted experience evidence, and a candidate-experience-authority-compatible log entry ready to close the loop, in one composed circuit.

observableConditions.statement: the admitted evidence retains the same market signal and evidence fact ids as the originally resolved gap
the composed request handed to each nested capability contains exactly its declared request branch, not the whole carrier
the terminal admission status reflects genuine end-to-end obligation coverage and proof, not an assumed success
a candidate-experience-authority-compatible log entry is projected only when the admission status is ADMITTED, and is null otherwise
